hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); base=$(basename "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$base" == .env* && "$base" != .env.example && "$base" != .env.sample ]]; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Blocked: direct edits to .env files are disabled by policy (AGENTS.md: secrets go through env.ts, not raw .env edits). Edit via your secrets manager or .env tooling instead."}}'; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); if [ -n "$f" ]; then case "$f" in */apps/*) base=$(basename "$f"); case "$base" in env.ts|proxy.ts) : ;; *) case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) if grep -qE 'process\.env\.' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then jq -n --arg f "$f" '{systemMessage: ($f + " uses process.env directly; route access through this apps env.ts wrapper per AGENTS.md.")}'; fi ;; esac ;; esac ;; esac; fi 2>/dev/null || true
